title: 引语提示与观点提炼
goal: 解释引语表达的观点；选出与引语一致的中心论点。

points.label: 选出与引语一致的中心论点

sources.title: 大学英语四级（CET-4）：课表
sources.used: 引语提示与观点提炼的教学范围、知识点及写作小测规格

body.p: 解释引语时，先保留关键词之间的关系，再把观点用到题目给的情境中。重复引语的词语不算解释。论点用了相同的主题词，意思也可能与引语相反。

body.box: Learning requires more than collecting answers; it also requires examining how those answers were reached.

body.p: more than 和 also 表示收集答案之外，还要理解得出答案的过程。答案本身的价值没有被否定。本课的引语都是自编材料，不对应真实作者。

steps.d: 把对象与判断分开。collecting answers 是行为，examining how 指进一步理解过程。
保留 more than、not only、when 等关系。more than collecting 不能解释为 never collecting。
在指定情境中提出与解释一致的主张。学习解题方法的论点可写 Students should compare the reasoning behind different solutions。

cards.title: 引语与解释
rows: Learning requires more than collecting answers; it also requires examining how those answers were reached.
Collecting answers is not the only thing that learning requires from students.
Students should stop collecting answers because reasoning makes all answers unnecessary for learning.
Understanding the reasoning behind an answer is an essential part of learning from it.
A team benefits from different opinions only when its members examine those differences together.
Different opinions help a team only when its members look at the differences together.
A team should remove differing opinions so that members can reach agreement without discussion.
Different views become useful when members discuss and compare the reasons behind them.
Responsibility includes correcting the consequences of a mistake, not merely admitting that it happened.
Responsibility means more than admitting that a mistake happened and involves its consequences.
Admitting a mistake removes the need to take further action over its consequences.
Acknowledging an error should be followed by action to address the harm it caused.
关系限制
more than / only when / not merely
All answers are useless; all disagreements are helpful; every admission solves the problem.
保留补充、条件和行动的要求，不写成绝对判断。

cards.title: 解释与中心论点
rows: 学习：解题讨论
Students should explain the reasoning behind their solutions when comparing answers in a study group.
论点落在讲清解题思路上，答案仍然要比较。
合作：方案选择
Project teams should compare the reasons behind competing proposals before selecting a shared plan.
论点落在共同比较理由这一条件上。
责任：误发活动日期
An organizer who shares an incorrect date should issue a correction to the affected participants.
论点要求纠正错误的后果，不止承认失误。
反例：合作引语
Project teams should accept every proposal because all differences automatically improve their final decisions.
automatically 去掉了 only when 的条件。

body.box: Quotation: Careful learning involves checking an explanation, not simply repeating its conclusion. Context: A student is preparing a demonstration of a balance scale. The student remembers the final answer but has not checked why adding a weight changes the result. An essay should explain the quotation and apply it to this preparation.

body.p: checking an explanation 和 repeating its conclusion 是一组对比。引语的观点是要核对解释，只复述结论不够。

body.box:
Which thesis fits the quotation?
1. Remembering the final answer makes further checking unnecessary during preparation.
2. Preparation should include testing why the added weight changes the balance.
3. A correct conclusion proves that every part of the explanation has been checked.
4. Checking an explanation matters only when the final answer cannot be remembered.

body.p: 第二项把 checking 落实为 testing why，并用到了天平的情境。第四项加了引语没有的 only when 条件。

cards.title: 干扰项
rows: 字面复述
Careful learning is learning that checks explanations instead of simply repeating conclusions.
只复述引语，没有说明核对的作用。
程度扩大
Remembering conclusions is always harmful to learning and should therefore be avoided entirely.
not simply 只说复述不够，没有说结论有害。
关系倒置
Repeating a conclusion is enough to establish that its explanation has been checked.
引语说复述结论不够，这里却说复述就够了。
话题替换
A balance scale should be stored carefully to prevent damage during the next demonstration.
只用了同一个道具，观点与引语无关。

items.stem: 'Practice becomes useful when errors are examined.' Which interpretation preserves the condition?
options: Practice helps when learners investigate what went wrong.
Practice helps because errors always disappear through repetition.
Examining errors removes the need for any further practice.
Useful practice requires avoiding tasks in which errors occur.
items.why: when errors are examined 是练习有用的条件。第一项用 investigate what went wrong 保留了这个条件。

items.stem: 'Sharing tasks does not remove the need to share information.' Which thesis fits a poster project?
options: Members should finish separate tasks without discussing their progress.
Members should exchange progress reports while working on separate sections.
Members should replace all individual tasks with repeated group meetings.
Members should share information only after the completed poster is printed.
items.why: does not remove the need 表示分工以后仍要交流信息。第二项写的是各做一部分，同时交换进度。

items.stem: 'A promise matters when it guides later action.' What does this emphasize?
options: The words in a promise are more important than subsequent conduct.
Later action matters only when someone has made a promise in advance.
A commitment gains practical value when it influences subsequent behavior.
Making a promise guarantees that all later actions will be successful.
items.why: when it guides later action 把承诺的价值和之后的行动联系起来，即第三项。第二项把这层关系倒了过来。

items.stem: 'Advice has value when it is considered, not merely collected.' Which thesis fits seeking career advice?
options: Students should collect as many suggestions as possible without comparing their relevance.
Students should reject advice because collecting suggestions cannot guarantee a suitable career.
Students should accept every suggestion because all advice deserves the same response.
Students should assess how each suggestion relates to their own circumstances and aims.
items.why: considered 指认真评估，not merely collected 指不能只收集。第四项要求结合自身情况评估每条建议。

groups.text: Quotation: Respect for shared space appears in daily actions, not only in written rules. A group uses a common art studio. Members have agreed to clean the worktables, but some leave paint on them. An essay should explain the quotation and apply it to the gap between the agreement and actual behavior.

items.stem: Which thesis follows from the quotation and context?
options: Studio members should put their cleaning agreement into practice after each session.
Studio members should replace cleaning with a more detailed written agreement.
Studio members should remove the agreement because written rules never have value.
Studio members should leave cleaning to whoever next needs the shared tables.
items.why: 引语强调 daily actions，情境中有人违反约定留下颜料。论点应是把清洁约定落实到行动上，即第一项。

items.stem: Complete an interpretation of the quotation.
items.why: 引语的重点在 daily actions，与 daily conduct 对应。written rules alone 与 not only 的意思相反。

groups.text: Quotation: A question left unresolved can support learning if it leads to further investigation. Context: A student cannot explain why two paper models bend differently. Instead of copying a classmate's conclusion, the student compares the folds. An essay should interpret the quotation and propose a suitable approach to this uncertainty.

items.stem: Which interpretation preserves the quotation's condition?
options: Uncertainty can aid learning when it motivates an effort to investigate.
Uncertainty aids learning even when no attempt is made to investigate.
Copying a conclusion is the only reliable response to an unresolved question.
Leaving a question unresolved is more valuable than any eventual explanation.
items.why: if it leads to further investigation 是条件。第一项用 when it motivates an effort to investigate 保留了这个条件。第二项去掉了条件。

items.stem: Which thesis applies the quotation to the models?
options: Students should copy a conclusion before examining any difference between the models.
Students should examine the folds to investigate the unexplained difference in bending.
Students should leave both models unexplained because uncertainty is always beneficial.
Students should accept different bending as proof that further investigation is unnecessary.
items.why: 情境中学生 compares the folds，这就是进一步调查。第二项把这一做法写成了论点。

items.stem: Complete an interpretation preserving the condition.
items.why: through further investigation 保留了引语的条件。情境中学生没有照抄结论，copying a conclusion 与此相反。

items.stem: Complete the proposed focus for the essay.
items.why: investigating 对应 further investigation。ignoring 与引语的要求相反。

groups.text: Quotation: Shared responsibility requires noticing unfinished work, not simply finishing an assigned part. Context: A student team is preparing an oral-history display. One member has completed the captions, but the team still lacks permission to use an interview. The essay should discuss responsibility for the unfinished shared task without suggesting that permission can be ignored.

options: Finishing an assigned part removes responsibility for unfinished work elsewhere.
Shared work can be completed as soon as any member finishes one part.
Responsibility extends to recognizing work that the whole team still needs to complete.
Noticing unfinished work makes it unnecessary for members to finish their assigned parts.
items.why: not simply finishing an assigned part 表示责任不止完成自己那部分，还包括留意全队没完成的事，即第三项。

items.stem: Which thesis fits the display context?
options: Completed captions mean the team can display the interview without further action.
The caption writer should ignore permission because the captions are already finished.
The team should replace permission with a statement that the captions are complete.
Members should identify who will obtain permission before using the interview publicly.
items.why: 情境说 still lacks permission，并要求不能忽视授权。第四项让队员确定由谁去取得授权。

items.stem: Complete an interpretation of the shared obligation.
items.why: 引语要求留意 unfinished work。already finished 把重点放回了已完成的部分。

items.stem: Complete the thesis that addresses the remaining task.
items.why: obtains 对应还缺的授权。ignores 与题目的要求相反。
